method: AB probe of the step 8 follow-up round: this branch's handler, `main`'s handler, and this branch again, the identical-binary control, in each round in a rotated order, a one-child control parent beside every many-child sweep, and every visit reset to no mounts and a fresh store, receipts and claims. After the interleaved rounds each arm is swept with a thread mounting and unmounting a tmpfs throughout, which moves the namespace's mount table under every answer. The probe is `keep/ab-probe.rs` in the round's folder. `main` is 96891c4152, the commit this branch merged. The second run is the same guest after a reboot, with the identical-binary control added to the changing-table phase; the guest's own times were slower throughout that run (its 1,024-clone fixture took 296 s against 388 s in the run before it), which is why every figure is a ratio to `main` measured in the same rounds.

syscallCost.measuredBy: keep/standing-answer-syscall-cost.c, built with gcc -O2 and run three times in the same guest
syscallCost.note: counted with `strace -f -y -e trace=openat,read,statmount,statx` in the same guest at 1,024 standing clones: the branch asked statmount 1,024 times and both handlers asked statx 15,379 times, because the slot walk's own statx carries the unique number
